entities.name: Virgilio López Irías
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Virgilio López Irias O.F.M. was a Honduran clergyman and bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Trujillo (Honduras). He became ordained in 1973. He was appointed bishop in 1987. He died in 2004.
